summary.text: CADEL SOLUTIONS AS is a private limited company registered in Stavanger, founded 2017-02-20. Cadel Solutions AS driver med rådgivning, BIM og konsulentarbeid innen elektro, automasjon og telecom, samt annen virksomhet som naturlig faller inn under dette. Its main industry code is 71.129: other technical consultancy. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 30 355 928 NOK and the annual result was 5 737 670 NOK; operating income was up from 25 228 451 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 5 025 702 NOK in 2024 to 5 737 670 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 244 297 NOK in 2024 to 2 985 953 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is cadel.no, which links to its Facebook, LinkedIn profiles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-13 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
